To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
community science can help improve community capacity to implement evidence-based prevention programming, thereby improving health outcomes at the local community level.
Community Science can be used to improve community capacity, which can lead to improved health outcomes.

1) community capacity can improve the quality of prevention programming; 2) community capacity can be improved through technology; and 3) a Community Science approach to research can improve the effectiveness of prevention.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a science of community capacity that can help communities implement high-quality prevention programs and achieve better outcomes.
the development and evaluation of technologies designed to enhance community capacity for high-quality prevention.
the development of a community science agenda that focuses on improving community capacity for effective prevention programming.

a Community Science research agenda can help build community capacity for effective preventive interventions, which in turn can lead to better health outcomes.
the research agenda described in this paper will help communities to implement evidence-based interventions more effectively, and in doing so, improve community health.
community science is a promising approach that can be used to improve the implementation of evidence-based interventions in local communities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are working to improve the quality of prevention programs in communities by developing and testing new technologies that enhance the capacity of community members to implement these programs well.
community capacity can improve the quality of evidence-based prevention programming.
community science is the study of the science of communities.

a new research model is needed to improve community capacity, and that this model is based in Community Science.
community science is a promising approach that can help narrow the science-to-practice gap in community-based health interventions.
